headline: Saudi escalation keeps weekend Stress extreme while Tail stays low without live NQ structure
body: NQ futures are closed, so directional efficiency, pullback depth and failed retracements cannot be observed. Reuters reports Houthi claims of attacks on Riyadh targets and an Aramco facility in Yanbu, while Saudi export adaptation through Gulf routes partly offsets supply disruption. Friday's Nasdaq strength was semiconductor-led but broad market breadth was negative, with Treasury yields near 5% and oil above $100. Fresh supplementary Finviz context remained mixed across megacaps despite positive semiconductor breadth. These conditions support extreme Stress and reopening-gap uncertainty, but they do not establish a persistent NQ Tail path.
